assumptions: Target organism is human; assay organisms are reported in selection.json under confidence >=8.
Grouping uses full standardized InChIKey; distinct nonempty document IDs establish independent documents.
All pActivity values are medians of pChEMBL, never medians of mixed activity types.
Fixed seed and pinned versions reproduce numbers on the same cached responses and numerical runtime.
Model labels use both nested q2 values, scaffold-test r2 and the full-pipeline scrambling check.

fit_surface.note: Conditional two-descriptor slice of the training model; others held at training medians. MolLogP_squared is always recomputed from MolLogP. Unselected axes have no model effect; combinations need not correspond to realizable molecules.

sources.cid_mapping: Exact full InChIKey after identical standardization of existing explorer structures

verdict: This model is not predictive: scaffold-group 5-fold q²=-0.285, LOO q²=0.071, and scaffold-holdout r²=-0.090 (RMSE=1.256 pChEMBL units). The real full-data r²=0.152 exceeds every one of the 100 reselected y-scramble fits (maximum=0.126; empirical p=0.0099); the real r² must exceed this distribution to pass the scrambling check. Drugs grouped by a common target are not a congeneric series, so this Hansch-style fit is exploratory. Post-selection coefficient p-values are descriptive and do not establish causal substituent effects.
